notes: FL-Studio-style hands-on editing everywhere it makes sense: the piano roll now DRAWS — press an empty spot to create a note and keep dragging to place it, drag notes to move them (snapping to the grid and semitones, auditioning as the pitch changes), drag a note's right edge to stretch it, right-click to erase (sweep to erase many). The step sequencer PAINTS — press and drag across cells. Drag tracks by their handle to reorder the mixer. Drop an audio file straight onto the Tracks page and it becomes a sampler (drop onto an existing sampler to swap its sound). And in the Jam: drag a chord from the palette onto any section chip to add it there, and drag chords within the section editor to reorder the progression.
